text: Ironvale Athletic successfully shifted momentum around the 57th minute by exploiting their 5-3-2 formation to absorb Redmond Rovers' high press and launch direct, vertical counter-attacks. Their deeper defensive line combined with quick transitions resulted in 3 final third entries and 3 shots, two of which were blocked and one saved, creating clear offensive pressure despite less possession [#1015] [#1066] [#1133]. Meanwhile, Redmond’s 4-3-3 style with a high defensive line was disrupted, leading to fewer dangerous touches inside the box even with higher possession and pass accuracy. Coaching point: Reinforce Redmond’s midfield pressing coordination to prevent Ironvale’s vertical passing lanes and reduce the effectiveness of their counter-attacks in breaking through the press.
